title: 2.209 teaser blueprint hides an "Oct 1" easter egg
summary: RobTop posted a blueprint image on X on 5 Sep 2026 with a hidden "10:1" notation that the community reads as pointing to an October 1 release for 2.209. Not an explicit date from RobTop himself - just the community's best guess so far, alongside his own Discord comments that 2.209 is "lots of QoL stuff" before work shifts to 2.21.
author: Community (blueprint decode)
